description: This source file implements the game logic for a command-line Rock Paper Scissors game, including game state management, user interaction, and game rules with an optional secret mode.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Represents the state and logic for a game of Rock Paper Scissors, including player choices, scores, game mode, and game progression.

methods.name: NewGame
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Game instance with specified number of rounds and secret mode setting.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Processes a single round of the game based on the player's choice, updating game state accordingly.

methods.name: getComputerChoice
methods.description: Randomly selects the computer's move, considering secret mode options.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner of the current round based on choices.

methods.name: updateScore
methods.description: Updates scores based on the current round's winner.

methods.name: isGameOver
methods.description: Checks if the game has concluded based on scores or number of games played.

methods.name: getGameOverMessage
methods.description: Generates the final message after game completion indicating the winner or draw.

methods.name: getRoundResultMessage
methods.description: Provides a concise message describing the outcome of the current round.

methods.name: PlayGame
methods.description: Main function to manage the game flow, including user prompts, playing rounds, and displaying results.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Safely converts a string representation of a number into an integer, defaulting to 3 if parsing fails.
